title: Research Package 15 — Stagehand Fundamentals: Entry-Level Role Validation
jurisdiction_scope: synthesis of cited US employer, municipal, union and education sources
role_scope: entry-level/general stagehand role identity, call phases, duties and progression
notes: Composite research provenance. Exact learner-facing external claims should retain or later receive direct edges to the underlying sources where material.

title: Research Package 16 — Stagehand Fundamentals Safety & PPE Validation
jurisdiction_scope: synthesis of US federal safety sources plus industry/employer attire context
role_scope: entry-level safety, rights, PPE, hazard communication, show clothing, heat/fatigue readiness
freshness_trigger: underlying OSHA/industry source changes or claim correction
notes: Awareness-level research only; does not create OSHA Outreach, employer training or certification. Later matrix correction rejects its older high-visibility/1910.135 attribution where applicable.

title: Research Package 17 — Stagehand Fundamentals Jobsite Hazard Awareness Validation
jurisdiction_scope: synthesis of US federal safety sources and live-event standards/guidance
role_scope: entry-level hazard recognition, equipment/operator boundaries, outdoor/site hazards and escalation
notes: Supports recognition/avoid/report/escalate. Does not authorize powered equipment, rigging, automation or other controlled systems.

title: Research Package 18 — Stagehand Fundamentals: Load-In and Load-Out Validation
jurisdiction_scope: synthesis of US employer, municipal, union and OSHA/NIOSH evidence
role_scope: load-in/load-out, material flow, docks/trailers and general-stagehand operational phases
notes: Strongly supports phase/duty claims. Explicitly does not support a universal claim that load-out is categorically more hazardous than load-in or that all beginners follow one assignment sequence.

title: Research Package 19 — Stagehand Fundamentals: Tools, Gear, Handling, Hiring, and Career Growth Validation
jurisdiction_scope: synthesis of occupational guidance, union/local, employer and industry sources
role_scope: entry-level tool/cable/material handling plus hiring/union/non-union/career pathways
freshness_trigger: underlying tool/cable guidance, hiring/local or career evidence changes
notes: Distinguishes industry handling practice from regulation and rejects one national hiring route or standardized first-30-days progression.

title: Research Package 20 — Stagehand Fundamentals Gap Audit & Supplemental Validation
jurisdiction_scope: supplemental synthesis of cited OSHA/industry sources
role_scope: Fundamentals housekeeping, egress, near-miss reporting, movement visibility, tools, communication and onboarding gaps
freshness_trigger: underlying source or current-course wording changes
notes: Supplements Packages 15–19. Preserves unresolved/non-universal status for radio vocabulary, 30-day onboarding and comparative load-out danger.

title: Research Package 20A — Stagehand Fundamentals Gap-Audit Addendum
role_scope: show blacks, stagecraft tools, cable handling, show-call trust, onboarding variation, communication/check-in and fatigue/cleanup
notes: Addendum strengthens specific thin areas and does not supersede Package 20. Local/institution practices remain examples rather than national rules.
